verdict.rationale: Lithic documents dated API versioning via the `api-version` header, letting integrators control when changes reach them (lithic-docs-7, lithic-docs-21, lithic-docs-28), and migration guidance exists for at least one API transition preserving schema/headers for smooth transition (lithic-docs-23, lithic-docs-31). However, there's no explicit documented deprecation policy (timelines, sunset notice periods, versioning changelog) beyond the header mechanism. Missing for 10: explicit deprecation policy/timeline documentation, versioned changelog, sunset notice commitments, independent corroboration of version stability.
